visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a blue and white striped shirt and a denim overall skirt, speaks directly to the camera in a modern building hallway with white marble walls and brown doors. She uses animated hand gestures and facial expressions to introduce the topic. (2) Scene shifts outdoors where two young children, a boy and a girl, are riding a tricycle and a scooter on a paved yellow and grey brick walkway surrounded by high-rise residential towers under bright daylight. (3) The children are seen playing in a shallow outdoor water fountain area with a man in a black t-shirt; they are splashing water and holding colorful water guns in a recreational public space. (4) The woman returns to the screen indoors, explaining housing priorities for families. (5) A room tour begins, showcasing a clean, well-lit three-bedroom apartment featuring a living room with a grey sofa, wooden dining table, and empty bedrooms with grey walls and wood-textured flooring. (6) The camera shows a balcony with sliding glass doors and an air conditioning unit installed high on the wall. (7) The woman appears again in the marble hallway, using her fingers to count while graphic text bubbles and icons appear around her to illustrate eligibility rules. (8) The final shot shows the woman standing outside a building entrance, gesturing towards the camera as she concludes her explanation of rental subsidies.
